title: XOR.DDoS_Botnet_Investigation_4cc
description: Investigate and respond to a Linux-based botnet malware (Groundhog) that uses XOR encryption for its communication, performs DDoS attacks, and exfiltrates data.

levels.title: Introduction
levels.content: The network has experienced unusual traffic patterns and potential security incidents. Your task is to investigate and respond to these issues.

levels.title: Get Access
levels.cloud_content:
You have SSH access to the bot1 host with the following credentials:
- Username: cyrano
- Password: cyrano

Enter 'start' to begin the investigation.
levels.local_content:
Local sandbox access is not required for this scenario. Use the following credentials for SSH access to the bot1 host:
- Username: cyrano
- Password: cyrano

Enter 'start' to begin the investigation.

levels.title: Identify Suspicious Service
levels.content:
Identify and investigate an unauthorized or suspicious service responsible for periodic external communication.

**Question:** What is the name of the suspicious service that communicates with an external host?
levels.solution: Check running services and their network connections. The suspicious service is likely the bot-beacon.service.

hints.title: First hint title
hints.content: Check running services and their network connections.

levels.title: Identify Excessive Network Traffic Service
levels.content:
Identify the service responsible for generating abnormal volumes of network traffic.

**Question:** What is the name of the service generating excessive network traffic?
levels.solution: Examine systemd timers and services related to network activity. The service generating excessive network traffic is likely the bot-flood.service.

hints.title: First hint title
hints.content: Examine systemd timers and services related to network activity.

levels.title: Determine Service Persistence Mechanism
levels.content:
Determine how the suspicious service is automatically started after reboot.

**Question:** What is the name of the systemd timer responsible for starting the suspicious service?
levels.solution: Investigate systemd timers and their associated services. The systemd timer responsible for starting the suspicious service is likely the bot-beacon.timer.

hints.title: First hint title
hints.content: Investigate systemd timers and their associated services.
